text: Walking through these corridors, I sense an atmosphere of curiosity and inquiry, as if each room shelters minds at work and ideas in gestation. The glass-walled meeting space evokes transparency yet also a separation, inviting observation but not intrusion. Moving into the vibrant exhibition, the bold "R+D" demands attention—here, innovation and discovery are not hidden away, but celebrated and displayed. I feel invigorated by the tangible evidence of active thought and progress, yet slightly humbled by the vastness of collective knowledge. I am both observer and participant, swept into the momentum of continual development.
